title: Functional and transcriptional heterogeneity of human hemopoietic lympho-myeloid progenitors
description: Cord blood (CB) samples from normal donors were obtained with informed consent. Fresh CB samples were processed within 18-34h after collection. Mononuclear cells were isolated and CD34+ fraction was separated. CB CD34+ enriched fraction was lineage depleted by staining with purified anti-human CD2, CD3, CD4, CD7, CD8a, CD11b, CD14, CD19, CD20, CD56, CD235a followed by Qdot 605 conjugated goat F(ab')2 anti-mouse IgG (H+L). Cells were also stained with anti-human CD38-FITC, CD45RA-PE or -BV650, CD123-PE Cy7, CD90-biotin, CD34- PerCP and CD10-APC. Finally, cells were incubated with streptavidin-conjugated APC-eF780 and Hoechst 33258 (Invitrogen, final concentration: 1 μg/ml). Populations were defined, as follows: HSC - Lin-CD34+CD38-CD90+CD45RA-CD10-, MPP - Lin-CD34+CD38-CD90-CD45RA-CD10-, LMPP - Lin-CD34+CD38-CD90-/loCD45RA+CD10-, MLP - Lin-CD34+CD38-CD90-/loCD45RA+CD10+, GMP - Lin-CD34+CD38+CD123+CD45RA+CD10-, CMP - Lin-CD34+CD38+CD123+CD45RA-CD10-, MEP - Lin-CD34+CD38+CD123-CD45RA-CD10-.

samples.title: OX_PV_062
samples.description: Protocols: 100 (or less, if 100 were not available) highly purified Haematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs) from cord blood samples were sorted directly into lysis buffer in RNAse inhibitor (Clontech) and stored at -80°C before further processing. cDNA synthesis was done with Smarter Ultra low input RNA kit v1 (Clontech). Illumina libraries were generated using Nextera XT DNA (Illumina). Library size and quality were checked using Agilent High-Sensitivity DNA chip with Agilent Bioanalyser (Agilent Technologies). Concentration of indexed libraries was determined using Qubit High-Sensitivity DNA kit (Invitrogen).
